family: Actual independent Boolean data cores with identical physical fallback at point reveals; exact binary arbitrary-controller substitution

point.domain: all 22x22 n<=2 core tables, live widths (2,1),(3,1),(2,2)

binary.domain: all 16^3 controller/u/v two-bit tables, both controller queries and each first per-core data query

symmetry: none; bounded caching cleared every32 cases, no mean-only replacement of spectra
arithmetic: exact Fraction Walsh and prime-log vectors; rational 24-term atanh interval/tail for signs
